## Background

Commit `cf30a02` (2026-03-13 11:39 CET) introduced a bug in `convert_proteomics_se()`
where the `fid_lookup` table paired **p-value-sorted** feature_ids with **unsorted**
SE rownames. This caused ~99.9% of proteins in the countList to be assigned the
wrong expression values.

**Affected**: all proteomics count-based visualisations (boxplots, heatmaps,
correlations) since 2026-03-13.

**Not affected**: DE table, volcano plots, p-values, log2FC (these come from
seqAnno which is internally consistent).

**Fix**: Build `fid_lookup` from the unsorted contrast_df instead of the sorted
`seqAnnoList`. Applied in:

- `R/helperFunctions.R`
- `inst/app/server-initInputData.R`
- `inst/app/input_example.R`

This document re-runs the verification from scratch.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

source("R/helperFunctions.R")
```

```{r download, cache=TRUE}
se_list <- lapply(datasets, function(url) readRDS(url(url)))
```

## Test 1: Every countList value matches the raw SE

For each dataset, we verify that every feature_id in the countList maps back to the
correct row in the original SE, and that all sample values are identical.

```{r test1_value_integrity}
verify_values <- function(se, label) {
  result <- convert_proteomics_se(se)

  # Build reverse lookup: feature_id -> original SE rowname
  rd_names <- names(rowData(se))
  contrasts <- gsub("constrast_", "", rd_names[grep("^constrast_", rd_names)])
  contrast_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(se)[[paste0("constrast_", contrasts[1])]])
  unsorted_sa <- standardise_columns(contrast_df)
  unsorted_sa$feature_id <- build_feature_id(unsorted_sa)
  reverse_lookup <- setNames(rownames(contrast_df), unsorted_sa$feature_id)

  results <- data.frame(
    dataset = character(),
    assay = character(),
    features_checked = integer(),
    errors = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (assay_name in names(result$countList)) {
    cl <- result$countList[[assay_name]]
    raw <- assay(se, assay_name)
    errors <- 0
    checked <- 0

    for (fid in rownames(cl)) {
      orig_rn <- reverse_lookup[fid]
      if (is.na(orig_rn)) next

      cl_vals <- unname(cl[fid, ])
      raw_vals <- unname(raw[orig_rn, ])

      match <- all(
        (is.na(cl_vals) & is.na(raw_vals)) |
        (!is.na(cl_vals) & !is.na(raw_vals) & cl_vals == raw_vals)
      )
      if (!match) errors <- errors + 1
      checked <- checked + 1
    }

    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      dataset = label,
      assay = assay_name,
      features_checked = checked,
      errors = errors,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  results
}

all_results <- do.call(rbind, mapply(verify_values, se_list, names(se_list), SIMPLIFY = FALSE))
kable(all_results, caption = "Value integrity: every feature_id checked against raw SE")
stopifnot(all(all_results$errors == 0))
cat("PASS: All", sum(all_results$features_checked), "feature-assay combinations match.\n")
```

## Test 2: seqAnno and countList feature_ids are aligned

The feature_ids in seqAnnoList must be a subset of (or equal to) the countList rownames,
and vice versa.

```{r test2_alignment}
verify_alignment <- function(se, label) {
  result <- convert_proteomics_se(se)

  results <- data.frame(
    dataset = character(),
    contrast = character(),
    seqAnno_not_in_countList = integer(),
    countList_not_in_seqAnno = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  cl_fids <- rownames(result$countList[[1]])

  for (con in names(result$seqAnnoList)) {
    sa_fids <- result$seqAnnoList[[con]]$feature_id
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      dataset = label,
      contrast = con,
      seqAnno_not_in_countList = length(setdiff(sa_fids, cl_fids)),
      countList_not_in_seqAnno = length(setdiff(cl_fids, sa_fids)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  results
}

alignment_results <- do.call(rbind, mapply(verify_alignment, se_list, names(se_list), SIMPLIFY = FALSE))
kable(alignment_results, caption = "seqAnno <-> countList feature_id alignment")
stopifnot(all(alignment_results$seqAnno_not_in_countList == 0))
stopifnot(all(alignment_results$countList_not_in_seqAnno == 0))
cat("PASS: Perfect alignment across all contrasts.\n")
```

## Test 3: The old (buggy) code produces wrong results

Demonstrate that the original `fid_lookup` built from `seqAnnoList` (sorted) produces
scrambled mappings.

```{r test3_bug_demonstration}
demonstrate_bug <- function(se, label) {
  rd_names <- names(rowData(se))
  contrasts <- gsub("constrast_", "", rd_names[grep("^constrast_", rd_names)])
  contrast_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(se)[[paste0("constrast_", contrasts[1])]])

  sa <- standardise_columns(contrast_df)
  sa$feature_id <- build_feature_id(sa)

  # OLD (buggy): sort, then build lookup with original rownames
  sa_sorted <- sa[order(sa$pValue), ]
  raw_rn <- rownames(contrast_df)
  fid_lookup_OLD <- setNames(sa_sorted$feature_id, raw_rn)

  # NEW (fixed): unsorted
  fid_lookup_NEW <- setNames(sa$feature_id, raw_rn)

  wrong <- sum(fid_lookup_OLD != fid_lookup_NEW)
  total <- length(fid_lookup_OLD)

  data.frame(
    dataset = label,
    total_features = total,
    wrong_old_code = wrong,
    correct_old_code = total - wrong,
    pct_wrong = round(100 * wrong / total, 2)
  )
}

bug_demo <- do.call(rbind, mapply(demonstrate_bug, se_list, names(se_list), SIMPLIFY = FALSE))
kable(bug_demo, caption = "Old (buggy) code: feature_id mismatch count")
```

## Test 4: Spot checks on known values

Manually verify specific protein values against the raw SE.

```{r test4_spot_checks}
spot_check <- function(se, feature_pattern, sample_name, label) {
  result <- convert_proteomics_se(se)

  # Find the feature
  fid <- grep(feature_pattern, rownames(result$countList$transformedData), value = TRUE)
  if (length(fid) == 0) return(NULL)
  fid <- fid[1]

  # Find original SE rowname
  rd_names <- names(rowData(se))
  contrasts <- gsub("constrast_", "", rd_names[grep("^constrast_", rd_names)])
  contrast_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(se)[[paste0("constrast_", contrasts[1])]])
  unsorted_sa <- standardise_columns(contrast_df)
  unsorted_sa$feature_id <- build_feature_id(unsorted_sa)
  orig_rn <- rownames(contrast_df)[unsorted_sa$feature_id == fid]

  countList_val <- result$countList$transformedData[fid, sample_name]
  raw_se_val <- assay(se, "transformedData")[orig_rn, sample_name]

  data.frame(
    dataset = label,
    feature_id = fid,
    original_rowname = orig_rn,
    sample = sample_name,
    countList_value = countList_val,
    raw_SE_value = raw_se_val,
    match = identical(countList_val, raw_se_val)
  )
}

spots <- rbind(
  spot_check(se_list[[2]], "P07910.*AAVAGEDGR", "K562_13", "peptide-level"),
  spot_check(se_list[[2]], "P0DP23.*DGDGTITTK", "K562_13", "peptide-level"),
  spot_check(se_list[[4]], "^creatinine$", "SB0787_U_V4_6", "protein-level (p41085)"),
  spot_check(se_list[[4]], "^P12277$", "SB0787_U_V4_6", "protein-level (p41085)")
)
kable(spots, caption = "Spot checks: specific feature values")
stopifnot(all(spots$match))
cat("PASS: All spot checks match.\n")
```
